messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Built Neon Pairs and generated the offline distribution: [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html).

The game includes deterministic board codes, snapshot export and import, paused resume behavior, saved best scores, keyboard navigation, and the replay CLI. Browser accessibility evidence is in [accessibility-tree.txt](/work/artifacts/accessibility-tree.txt).

Verification passed: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (13 tests), `npm run test:e2e` (5 journeys), and `npm run build`. The replay CLI’s valid and invalid output behavior was also checked. No screen reader was used.
